handoff: Pure prefactor verified: readTickInputs and readUnitHooks in store; golden, transcripts, observe snapshots unchanged; typecheck and full suite green (check-run timing flake once, green on rerun). No blocking findings; 2 minor, 1 nit.

findings.title: blockedHookCount now JSON-parses every hook line since the run's day
findings.detail:
Before this change it was a text match with no parse ('"blocked":true' plus the run_id needle). Now it goes through readUnitHooks, which parses every hook line since the run's day on each Stop hook. The output is the same, but norn hook is a hot path and the story is about the size of the trace.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Leave it as is: slice 04 (hook files) reworks this read. Or keep a substring pre-filter on the run_id before parsing.

findings.title: Per-unit hook selection can drop a run_id-matched fact that the old global list kept
findings.detail:
unitFacts' R5.1 path (observe run-facts.ts:71, view load.ts:170) selects by run_id only. It used to search every hook fact; now it searches only the facts hookOfUnit assigns to the unit by story/slice or cwd prefix. norn hook always stamps story/slice from the launch env or the marker, so a mismatch needs an inconsistent launch env. Parity holds in practice, and the pins confirm it.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally also count a fact as the unit's when its run_id is one of the unit's runs, or document the assumption in hookOfUnit's comment.

findings.title: Worktree prefix match without a path separator
findings.detail:
fact.cwd.startsWith(unit.worktree) makes /w/gh-9 claim the hooks of /w/gh-9--01, and also those of /w/gh-90. The test documents this as copying runHooks, so it is the intended parity. brief adds its own slash-aware filter on top.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: No change in this slice; revisit with runHooks if the prefix is ever tightened.
